blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 思维链推理在多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的视频理解上有很大的进步. 然而,基于语言的推理痕迹并不能为模型重新审视相关视觉证据提供可靠机制,导致视觉遗忘并损害其通过视频内容进行推理的能力. 现有方法在推理时主要以两种方式维持视觉地基:要么是指使用文字坐标的证据,该坐标指定了象征性位置,而不是视觉内容本身;要么将被裁剪的区域或框架重新插入多模式上下文,以大幅扩展上下文为代价保留视觉细节。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了VideoLVR,它构建了相关视频瞬间来自当地地区的潜在视觉证据,从而为中间推理步骤提供视觉支持. 为了监督潜在视觉证据的生成,我们引入了一个视觉符号预测目标,将视觉符号重建设定为对输入视频产生的词汇的预测,从而将视觉证据重建与文本生成统一在同一同物预测框架内. 这个共享的预测框架使 MLLMs 能够通过互放的文本符号和潜在视觉状态进行推理,同时整合不同时刻的证据. 我们进一步将VideoLVR扩展为强化学习,将被抽样的视觉标志与文本标志一起作为行动,并利用最终的答案奖励共同优化政策。 通过在推理过程中高效地重新审视与任务相关的视觉信息,VideoLVR可以改善视频理解,而不会大幅度地扩展多模式背景. 对多段视频基准的实验显示了其有效性,特别是在需要精细图像证据的任务方面.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled increasingly complex video understanding and reasoning. Supervised chain-of-thought training and reinforcement learning have further strengthened these capabilities, allowing models to solve video questions that require temporal localization and multi-step reasoning ( Feng et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2025 ; Maaz et al. 2025 ) . However, the resulting traces remain largely language-based. As reasoning proceeds, models may gradually lose access to task-relevant visual evidence, resulting in visual forgetting and limiting their ability to reason over video content ( Sun et al. 2025 ; Sun et al. 2026 ) . This makes it difficult to revisit the localized and temporally sparse evidence required by later steps.
blocks.zh: 最近在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)方面取得的进展使得视频理解和推理变得日益复杂。 监督的思维链培训和强化学习进一步加强了这些能力,使模型能够解决需要时间定位和多步骤推理的视频问题(冯等人. 2025; 王等编. 2025年; Maaz等人,2025年). 然而,由此产生的痕迹在很大程度上仍然是基于语言的。 随着推理的进行,模型可能会逐渐失去接触与任务相关的视觉证据的机会,导致视觉遗忘,并限制其理性能力超过视频内容(Sun等人. 2025; Sun et al. 2026 ). 这使得难以重新审视以后步骤所需的局部和时间上的零散证据。

blocks.en: One line of work grounds reasoning with textual coordinates, using timestamps for temporal evidence and bounding boxes for spatial evidence ( Maaz et al. 2025 ; Meng et al. 2026 ; Fan et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2026a ) . Although compact and traceable, these coordinates encode the locations of evidence rather than its visual content. Other methods invoke visual tools to crop or zoom into image regions, or to select additional video frames and clips ( Zheng et al. 2026 ; Jiang et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2026a ) . Although these tools expose fine-grained visual details, tool-augmented reasoning is limited to a predefined set of visual operations ( Li et al. 2025 ) . Moreover, each returned crop, frame, or clip must be re-encoded and inserted into the multimodal context, causing the context to grow as visual tool calls accumulate, particularly in video reasoning ( Li et al. 2025 ; Zheng et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026a ) . Neither formulation provides a compact and flexible way to revisit relevant visual content while preserving its visual semantics.
blocks.zh: 一线工作场推理带有文字坐标,使用时间戳作为时间证据,并用边框作为空间证据(Maaz等人,2001年)。 2025; Meng等人著. 2026; Fan et al. 2025; Wang et al. 2026a ). 虽然这些坐标是紧凑和可追踪的,但它们编码了证据的位置,而不是其视觉内容。 其他方法引用视觉工具来裁剪或放大成图像区域,或选择额外的视频帧和剪辑(郑等人. 2026; 蒋等. 2025; 张等 2026a. 虽然这些工具暴露出精细的视觉细节,但工具强化推理仅限于一套预定义的视觉操作(Li等人,2025年). 此外,每个返回的裁剪、帧或剪辑必须重新编码并插入到多式联运上下文中,随着视觉工具呼叫的积累,特别是视频推理(Li et al. 2025; 郑等. 2026; 张等 2026a. 这两种提法都没有提供一个紧凑和灵活的方式,在保留其视觉语义的同时,重新审视相关的视觉内容。

blocks.en: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) ( Li et al. 2025 ) , which trains an MLLM to autoregressively reconstruct question-relevant visual tokens and interleave them with textual reasoning, offers a promising alternative by representing intermediate visual evidence with continuous hidden states rather than text or additional visual observations. However, most prior latent visual reasoning methods focus on the image domain, where latent states are learned using image-based visual targets or image-level bottlenecks ( Wang et al. 2026c ; Yang et al. 2026 ; Li et al. 2026 ; Wu et al. 2026 ; Miao et al. 2026 ; Xu et al. 2026 ) . In video reasoning, a single reasoning step may require local visual evidence from several moments. Evidence from any single moment may be insufficient. The model must relate visual information across time to support the reasoning step. Meanwhile, neighboring frames often contain similar visual tokens ( Fu et al. 2025 ; Tao et al. 2025 ) . MSE feature regression aligns each prediction with its target independently, without explicitly distinguishing that target from other visually similar tokens in the same video.
blocks.zh: Latent视觉推理(LVR)(Li et al. 2025),它训练一种MLLM自动重建与问题相关的视觉符号,并将它们与文字推理交互,它通过代表中间视觉证据与连续隐藏状态,而不是文本或额外的视觉观察,提供了一个很有希望的替代方案. 然而,大多数之前潜伏的视觉推理方法都侧重于图像域,其中潜伏状态是通过基于图像的视觉目标或图像级瓶颈来学习的(Wang et al. 2026c; 杨等. 2026; 李等编. 2026; 吴等. 2026; 廖等编. 2026; 许等 2026). 在视频推理中,一个单一推理步骤可能需要从几个时刻开始的局部视觉证据. 任何一刻的证据都可能不够充分。 该模型必须将视觉信息与时间联系起来,以支持推理步骤。 同时,相邻的帧往往含有类似的视觉标志(Fu等人,2025年;Tao等人,2025年). MSE特性回归将每个预测与目标独立地对齐,而没有将目标与同一视频中其他视觉相似的符号明确区分开来.

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce VideoLVR , which learns to generate latent visual evidence to support intermediate video reasoning. Each latent block represents evidence from local regions supporting the same reasoning step, allowing evidence from different video moments to be modeled jointly. We supervise these blocks with visual token sequences derived from spatio-temporal grounding annotations in evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories. To distinguish the target evidence from similar visual content, we introduce visual token prediction (VTP), which trains each latent query to predict its target token among all visual tokens from the input video. Together with next-token prediction for text, this objective trains VideoLVR to generate reasoning interleaved with latent visual evidence. At inference, the supervised VideoLVR model projects decoder hidden states into latent visual states and feeds them back into the model without inserting additional frames or region crops into the multimodal context. For reinforcement learning, we introduce text–visual policy optimization (TVPO), which samples visual tokens from the input video’s visual vocabulary using our visual token prediction formulation and jointly optimizes text and visual token actions with final-answer rewards.
Experiments across multiple video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, with particular gains on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce VideoLVR, which learns from evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories to construct grouped latent visual evidence from local regions across video moments, allowing temporally distributed evidence to be modeled jointly. • We propose visual token prediction (VTP) over the input video’s visual vocabulary, unifying latent visual evidence generation with text token prediction. Building on VTP, we introduce TVPO to jointly optimize text and visual token actions through reinforcement learning. • We evaluate VideoLVR across multiple video reasoning benchmarks and conduct extensive ablations of its key designs. The results show particular gains on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们引入VideoLVR,它学会生成潜在的视觉证据来支持中间视频推理. 每个潜在块代表来自当地地区支持同一推理步骤的证据,可以共同模拟不同视频时刻的证据。 我们用视觉信号序列来监督这些区块 从证据推理轨迹中的 斯皮提奥-时空定位说明中得出的 为了区分目标证据和相似的视觉内容,我们引入了视觉符号预测(VTP),它训练每个潜在的查询,从输入视频的所有视觉符号中预测其目标符号. 这个目标与文字的下切预测一起,对VideoLVR进行训练,以产生与潜在视觉证据相隔的推理. 在推论中,受监督的VideoLVR模型项目将隐藏状态解码为潜在的视觉状态,并将它们反馈到模型中,而不在多式联运中插入额外的帧或区域作物。 在强化学习方面,我们引入了文本-视觉政策优化(TVPO),它利用我们的视觉符号预测公式,对输入视频视觉词汇中的视觉符号进行抽样,并联合优化文本和视觉符号动作,并给予最终答案奖励。
跨越多个视频理解和推理基准的实验显示了其有效性,在需要精细视觉证据的任务上特别有收获. • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们介绍了VideoLVR,它从基于证据的推理轨迹中吸取了教训,在视频瞬间构建出来自当地区域的分组潜在视觉证据,从而可以共同模拟时间分布的证据。 我们提议对输入视频的视觉词汇进行视觉符号预测(VTP),将潜在的视觉证据生成与文字符号预测统一起来. 在 " VTP " 的基础上,我们引进了TVPO,通过强化学习,共同优化文字和视觉符号行动。 我们通过多个视频推理基准来评估VideoLVR,并对其关键设计进行广泛的盘点。 结果表明,在需要精细视觉证据的任务上取得了特别的进展。

blocks.en: We introduce VideoLVR, which learns from evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories to construct grouped latent visual evidence from local regions across video moments, allowing temporally distributed evidence to be modeled jointly.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍VideoLVR, 它从基于证据的推理轨迹中吸取教训, 在视频瞬间构建来自当地区域的集合潜在视觉证据, 从而可以共同模拟时间分布的证据。

blocks.en: We propose visual token prediction (VTP) over the input video’s visual vocabulary, unifying latent visual evidence generation with text token prediction. Building on VTP, we introduce TVPO to jointly optimize text and visual token actions through reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh: 我们提议对输入视频的视觉词汇进行视觉符号预测(VTP),将潜在的视觉证据生成与文字符号预测统一起来. 在VTP的基础上,我们引入了TVPO,通过强化学习共同优化文本和视觉符号行动.

blocks.en: We evaluate VideoLVR across multiple video reasoning benchmarks and conduct extensive ablations of its key designs. The results show particular gains on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多个视频推理基准来评估VideoLVR,并对其关键设计进行广泛的盘点。 结果表明,在需要精细视觉证据的任务上取得了特别的进展。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent work grounds video reasoning using explicit temporal and spatial references. Video-R2 improves temporal grounding through timestamp-aware supervision and a temporal alignment reward ( Maaz et al. 2025 ) , while Open-o3-Video interleaves timestamps and bounding-box coordinates with textual reasoning ( Meng et al. 2026 ) . Related image reasoning methods similarly localize relevant regions to ground intermediate reasoning ( Fan et al. 2025 ; Wang et al. 2026a ; Wang et al. 2026b ) . These methods make evidence traceable, but their coordinates encode symbolic locations rather than visual semantics.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作根据是使用明确的时间和空间参考的视频推理。 Video-R2通过时间戳-意识监督和时间调整奖励改进了时间定位(Maaz等人,2025年),而Open-o3-Video则通过文字推理来交互时间戳和边框坐标(Meng等人,2026年). 相关的图像推理方法类似地将相关区域定位为地面中间推理(Fan et al. 2025; 王等编. 2026a; 王等编. 2026b. (中文(简体) ). 这些方法使得证据可以追踪,但其坐标编码为符号位置而不是视觉语义.

blocks.en: Long multimodal reasoning can progressively forget visual information, motivating methods that revisit relevant evidence ( Sun et al. 2025 ; Sun et al. 2026 ) . DeepEyes and VLM-R 3 select and inspect image regions during reasoning ( Zheng et al. 2026 ; Jiang et al. 2025 ) . For videos, VITAL dynamically samples additional frames, while VideoSearcher combines temporal localization, spatial inspection, and multimodal search ( Zhang et al. 2026a ; Gao et al. 2026 ) . These methods recover fine-grained evidence by inserting regions, frames, or retrieved items as additional multimodal observations.
blocks.zh: 长的多式联运推理可以逐渐忘记视觉信息,激发重新审视相关证据的方法(Sun等人)。 2025; Sun et al. 2026 ). DeepEyes和VLM-R 3在推理过程中选择和检查图像区域(郑等人. 2026; 蒋等 2025). 对于视频,VITAL动态采样附加帧,而VideoSearcher结合了时间定位,空间检查,以及多式联运搜索(张等2026a;高等2026). 这些方法通过插入区域、框架或检索项目作为补充的多式联运观测结果来收回精细的证据。

blocks.en: Continuous latent reasoning has been explored in language models, with Coconut feeding hidden states back as input embeddings to perform intermediate computation without decoding it into text ( Hao et al. 2025 ) . Recent visual reasoning methods extend this idea by generating or refining latent visual representations. LVR reconstructs question-relevant visual tokens through latent states interleaved with textual reasoning ( Li et al. 2025 ) . Other approaches learn continuous visual thoughts through visual-semantic distillation, task supervision, reinforcement learning, or latent bottlenecks ( Wang et al. 2026c ; Yang et al. 2026 ; Li et al. 2026 ) . LaViT, GAP, and Semantic-Enriched Latent Visual Reasoning further improve latent supervision through attention distillation, feature-space alignment, curriculum gating, or region-centric attribute supervision ( Wu et al. 2026 ; Miao et al. 2026 ; Xu et al. 2026 ) . Diagnostic studies nevertheless show that models may bypass latent tokens, generate latents that deviate from their targets, or under-utilize their visual semantics because of shortcuts through the visual input ( Viveiros et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 在语言模型中探索了持续的潜伏推理,椰子将隐藏状态反馈回作为输入嵌入物进行中间计算,而不将其解码为文本(Hao等人,2025年)。 近期的视觉推理方法通过生成或精炼潜在的视觉表现来扩展这一想法. LVR通过潜在状态与文字推理相连接重建与问题相关的视觉符号(Li等人,2025年). 其他方法通过视觉语义提炼,任务监督,强化学习,或潜在的瓶颈来学习持续的视觉思想(Wang et al. 2026c; 杨等. 2026; Li 等人 2026). LaViT, GAP, 和语义丰富的Latent视觉理性通过注意力蒸馏,特征-空间对齐,课程定位,或以区域为中心的属性监督,进一步改善潜在监督(Wu等人. 2026; 廖等编. 2026; 许等 2026). 然而,诊断研究表明,模型可能绕过潜在信号,产生偏离目标的潜在信号,或者由于通过视觉输入的捷径而未充分利用其视觉语义(Viveiros等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b ).

blocks.en: Beyond continuous latent-state reasoning, Mull-Tokens uses a fixed set of modality-agnostic special tokens as a compact internal multimodal scratchpad, first aligning them with interleaved text–image traces and then relaxing training to final-answer supervision ( Ray et al. 2026 ) . UniVR instead autoregressively generates visual reasoning trajectories within the discrete token space of a unified generation model, targeting physical dynamics and long-horizon planning ( Ren et al. 2026 ) . VideoLatent extends latent reasoning to videos through latent injection, self-forcing, and alignment and diversity objectives trained from standard video question–answer triplets ( Hu et al. 2026b ) . However, these methods either provide generic computation slots, generate discrete visual trajectories, or learn video latents without step-level supervision from localized spatio-temporal evidence. VideoLVR addresses this gap by grouping temporally distributed local regions that support the same reasoning step and supervising latent visual evidence generation through prediction over the visual vocabulary of the input video.
blocks.zh: 除了持续的潜伏状态推理之外,Mull-Tokens还使用一套固定的模式不可知的特殊标志作为紧凑的内部多式抓图纸,首先将它们与互开的文本-图像痕迹相配合,然后放松对最后回答监督的培训(Ray等人,2026年)。 UniVR转而在统一生成模型的离散符号空间内自动生成视觉推理轨迹,瞄准物理动力学和长视距规划(Ren等人,2026年). VideoLatent通过潜在注射、自我强制、校准和多样性目标,从标准视频问答三重(Hu et al. 2026b)推广到视频。 然而,这些方法要么提供通用的计算槽,生成离散的视觉轨迹,要么从局部的时空证据中学习没有阶梯级监督的视频潜伏. VideoLVR通过将支持同一推理步骤的按时间分布的局部区域分组,并通过对输入视频的视觉词汇的预测来监督潜在的视觉证据生成,来弥补这一差距.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of VideoLVR. (a) A teacher MLLM synthesizes evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories through rejection sampling and trajectory polishing. (b) Visual tokens from regions supporting the same reasoning step are grouped and ordered by timestamp to form latent targets. VideoLVR jointly trains text generation with next-token prediction and latent visual evidence generation with visual token prediction over the input-video visual vocabulary. (c) At inference with the supervised model, each decoder hidden state is projected into a latent visual state and fed back as the input for the next decoding step, enabling autoregressive reasoning over latent visual evidence without additional visual observations.
blocks.zh: 图1:VideoLVR概览. (a) 一个教师MLLM通过拒绝取样和轨迹抛光来合成证据依据的推理轨迹。 (b) 对支持同一推理步骤的区域的视觉标志进行分组,并按时间戳排序,以形成潜在目标。 VideoLVR联合培训了文本生成,并配有下个托肯预测和潜在视觉证据生成,并配有输入-视频视觉词汇上的视觉符号预测. (c) 根据受监督的模型推论,每个解码器隐藏状态都投射为潜在的视觉状态,并作为下一个解码步骤的输入反馈,从而能够在没有额外视觉观察的情况下对潜在的视觉证据进行自转推理。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , VideoLVR first synthesizes evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories and converts supporting local regions into grouped latent targets, with regions within each target ordered by timestamp. It jointly learns text generation and latent visual evidence generation through next-token prediction and visual token prediction. During inference with the supervised model, decoder hidden states are projected into latent visual states and fed back autoregressively to support subsequent reasoning without introducing additional visual observations. We next describe the construction of grounded trajectories and grouped latent targets, followed by the learning objective and autoregressive inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,VideoLVR首先将基于证据的推理轨迹综合起来,并将支持地方区域转换成分组的潜在目标,每个目标内的区域按时间戳排序。 它通过下一代预测和视觉符号预测,共同学习文本生成和潜在视觉证据生成. 在对被监督模型的推断中,解码器隐藏状态被投射到潜伏的视觉状态中,并自动反馈回馈以支持后续的推理,而不引入额外的视觉观测. 我们接下来将阐述基础轨迹的构建和潜在目标的分组,然后是学习目标和自转推论程序。

blocks.en: 3.1 Evidence-Grounded Data Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1 证据组合数据综合

blocks.en: Starting from video question–answer data, we synthesize evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories through two stages: evidence-grounded trajectory rejection sampling and evidence-guided trajectory polishing.
blocks.zh: 从视频问答数据开始,我们综合了以证据为基础的推理轨迹,分两个阶段:以证据为基础的轨迹拒绝取样和以证据指导的轨迹抛光。

blocks.en:
For each video-question pair, we prompt a teacher MLLM to generate a reasoning trajectory that ends with a final answer.
The trajectory interleaves reasoning text with spatio-temporal visual evidence groups. We denote the k k -th evidence group by 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} , which associates an intermediate reasoning claim c k c_{k} with a sequence of localized visual regions ℛ k \mathcal{R}_{k} . Each region is specified by a timestamp and a bounding box. The regions in ℛ k \mathcal{R}_{k} may come from the same video moment or span multiple moments, allowing 𝒢 k \mathcal{G}_{k} to capture both spatially distributed evidence within a frame and temporally distributed evidence across frames.
blocks.zh:
对于每对视频提问,我们激励一位老师 MLLM 生成一个推理轨迹,以最后的答案结束.
轨迹将推理文本与时空视觉证据组相交. 我们表示由 G k\ mathcal{G}_{k} 组成的 k k -th 证据组, 将中间推理请求 c k c_{k} 与一系列局部视觉区域 R k\ mathcal{R}_{k} 联系起来 。 每个区域由时间戳和边框指定. Rk \ mathcal{R}_{k}中的区域可能来自同一视频瞬间或跨越多个瞬间,使得Gk \ mathcal{G}_{k}能够捕捉一个帧内空间分布的证据和跨帧时间分布的证据.

blocks.en: We apply rejection sampling based on answer correctness and evidence validity. A response is retained only if its final answer is judged equivalent to the reference answer and it contains at least one well-formed evidence group, with each group specifying a reasoning claim and one or more valid localized regions. We further reject malformed timestamps and invalid or overly broad bounding boxes. Rejected responses are resampled from the teacher using the validation errors as feedback. The accepted responses form the raw evidence-grounded trajectories passed to the polishing stage.
blocks.zh: 我们采用基于答案正确性和证据有效性的拒绝抽样。 只有在最后答复被判断为等同于参考答复,而且其中至少包含一个组成良好的证据小组,每个小组都具体说明推理要求和一个或多个有效的本地化区域的情况下,才保留答复。 我们还反对错误的时间戳和无效或过于宽泛的框框。 拒绝的回复由老师以校验错误作为反馈再作复制. 所接受的答复构成原始证据依据的轨迹,传到抛光阶段。

blocks.en: Although the teacher is instructed to interleave evidence groups with the reasoning steps that use them, rejection-sampled trajectories do not always exhibit the desired ordering. Evidence groups may appear after the relevant reasoning statements or cluster near the end of the response. Directly converting these groups into latent blocks would therefore misalign the latent evidence with the reasoning steps that use it.
blocks.zh: 虽然老师被指示让证据组与使用这些证据的推理步骤进行互动,但拒绝抽样的轨迹并不总是表现出期望的顺序. 证据组可能出现在相关推理陈述之后,或者在答复接近尾声时分组. 因此,直接将这些组变成潜在块会使潜在证据与使用的推理步骤错配。

blocks.en:
To correct this ordering, we provide the original video and rejection-sampled trajectory to the teacher MLLM, which rewrites the trajectory to adjust the
placement of evidence groups. The teacher preserves the original reasoning content while relocating each evidence group to the point where its visual evidence is used. We retain only trajectories that preserve the final answer, include every original evidence group exactly once, and place each group before the reasoning statement that uses the visual evidence it contains.
blocks.zh:
为了纠正这个命令,我们向教师MLLM提供原始视频和拒绝样本的轨迹,该轨迹改写了轨道以调整
设立证据小组。 老师保留了原推理内容,同时将每个证据组迁移到其视觉证据使用的地方. 我们只保留了保留最终答案的轨迹,包括每个原始证据组完全一次,并将每个组放在使用其包含的视觉证据的推理陈述之前.

blocks.en: We first map each localized visual region 𝐫 k , j \mathbf{r}_{k,j} to a target sequence ℰ k , j \mathcal{E}_{k,j} of visual token embeddings selected from the encoded video. Specifically, we map its timestamp t k , j t_{k,j} to the corresponding temporal position in the encoded video and project its normalized bounding box b k , j b_{k,j} onto the spatial token grid after visual token merging. We select the grid cells intersected by the projected box. Their visual token embeddings form ℰ k , j \mathcal{E}_{k,j} , ordered from left to right within each row and from top to bottom across rows.

We therefore introduce a visual token prediction objective over the input-video visual vocabulary. Let 𝒱 = ( 𝐯 1 , … , 𝐯 N ) \mathcal{V}=(\mathbf{v}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{v}_{N}) denote the candidate vocabulary formed by all N N visual tokens encoded from the input video. The tokens localized by spatio-temporal grounding serve as prediction targets.

blocks.en:
VideoLVR generates text autoregressively until it emits <bot> . For the supervised model, the hidden state corresponding to <bot> is mapped by the learned projection head g ϕ g_{\phi} into the first latent visual state,
which is used as the input embedding for the next decoding step. This process is repeated autoregressively: each subsequent decoder hidden state is projected into a latent visual state and fed back as the next latent input. Once K K latent visual states have been generated, the decoding procedure inserts <eot> and resumes text generation. For the reinforcement-learned model, we instead use the embeddings of sampled visual tokens as feedback.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We construct the training data from video question–answer samples released with OneThinker ( Feng et al. 2026 ) and Video-R1 ( Feng et al. 2025 ) . Following our evidence-grounded data synthesis pipeline described in Section 3.1 , we use Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking ( Bai et al. 2025a ) as the teacher model to generate and polish evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories in which localized spatio-temporal evidence is integrated into the reasoning process. We retain only answer-consistent trajectories after quality checks on the generated reasoning and evidence annotations. This process yields approximately 8.8K high-quality trajectories for training VideoLVR during supervised learning.
For reinforcement learning, we use 19K video multiple-choice questions from OneThinker, excluding questions that the supervised model answers correctly in all eight responses.
blocks.zh:
我们从OneThinker(冯等人,2026年)和Video-R1(冯等人,2025年)发布的视频问答样本中构建培训数据。 继我们第3.1节所述基于证据的数据合成管道之后,我们使用Qune3-VL-30B-A3B-思维(Bai等人,2025a)作为教师模型,生成和抛光基于证据的推理轨迹,将局部的语序证据纳入推理过程。 在对生成的推理和证据说明进行质量检查后,我们只保留符合答案的轨迹。 这个过程产生大约8.8K高品质的轨迹,用于在监督学习期间培训VideoLVR.
对于强化学习,我们使用来自OneThinker的19K视频多选题,不包括被监督模型在所有8个回复中正确回答的问题.

blocks.en: We compare VideoLVR with video MLLMs that follow different reasoning paradigms. Video-R1 ( Feng et al. 2025 ) and VideoRFT ( Wang et al. 2025 ) enhance text-space video reasoning through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. OneThinker ( Feng et al. 2026 ) provides a unified reasoning model for images and videos. Open-o3-Video ( Meng et al. 2026 ) generates timestamps and bounding boxes within textual reasoning trajectories to provide explicit spatio-temporal grounding. VideoSearcher ( Gao et al. 2026 ) combines temporal localization, spatial focusing, and multimodal search through multi-tool agentic reasoning for video deep research. LVR ( Li et al. 2025 ) reconstructs question-relevant visual features in a continuous representation space, while Mull-Tokens ( Ray et al. 2026 ) uses a fixed set of modality-agnostic latent tokens as an internal multimodal scratchpad. We additionally reproduce LVR with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on our 8.8K synthesized trajectories using its MSE feature regression objective and denote it as LVR-8B. We evaluate the released checkpoints of the protocol-aligned baselines using our evaluation setting. For VideoSearcher, we report results from its original evaluation setting and mark them with a dagger. For reference, we report Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025b ) together with the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025a ) backbone used by VideoLVR, enabling comparison with the corresponding models before video-reasoning training.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了VideoLVR和遵循不同推理范式的MLLMs视频. Video-R1(冯等人,2025年)和VideoRFT(王等人,2025年)通过监督微调和强化学习,加强文本空间视频推理. OneThinker(冯等人,2026年)为图像和视频提供了统一的推理模型. Open-o3-Video(Meng等人,2026年)在文字推理轨迹内生成时间戳和边框,以提供明显的斯皮提奥-时空地基. 视频搜索器 (Gao et al. 2026)通过多工具代理推理将时间定位,空间聚焦,多式联运搜索结合起来,进行视频深度研究. LVR(Li et al. 2025)在连续的表示空间中重建与问题相关的视觉特征,而Mull-Tokens(Ray et al. 2026)则使用一套固定的模式不可知的潜在符号作为内部的多式联运抓痕符. 我们用Qune3-VL-8B-指示在我们8.8K的合成轨迹上使用它的MSE特征回归目标进行LVR附加复制,并将其表示为LVR-8B. 我们利用我们的评估环境,评估已放行的、与协议一致的基线检查站。 对于VideoSearcher,我们报告其最初评价设定的结果,并用匕首标注. 供参考的是,我们报告Quen2.5-VL-7B-指示(Bai等人,2025b),以及VideoLVR使用的Quen3-VL-8B-指示(Bai等人,2025a)主干,从而可以在视频推理培训前与相应的模型进行比较。

For both training and evaluation, we sample videos at 2 FPS, retain at most 256 frames, and set the per-frame pixel budget to 131,072. blocks.en: We evaluate VideoLVR on five complementary video reasoning benchmarks. Video-MMMU ( Hu et al. 2026a ) assesses how models acquire and use knowledge from multidisciplinary professional videos across Perception, Comprehension, and Adaptation. TempCompass ( Liu et al. 2024 ) evaluates temporal perception across multiple temporal aspects and task formats while reducing reliance on static visual cues. MMVU ( Zhao et al. 2025 ) measures expert-level, knowledge-intensive reasoning over specialized videos from multiple disciplines. LongVideo-Reason ( Chen et al. 2025 ) focuses on reasoning over long videos from diverse real-world domains. VideoMathQA ( Rasheed et al. 2025 ) evaluates temporally extended mathematical reasoning that integrates visual, textual, and audio information from instructional videos.
blocks.zh: 我们评价VideoLVR的五个补充视频推理基准. Video-MMU(Hu et al. 2026a)评估模型如何从跨认知、理解和适应的多学科专业视频中获得和使用知识。 TempCompass(Liu等人,2024年)评价跨越多个时间方面和任务格式的时间感知,同时减少对静态视觉提示的依赖. MMVU (Zhao et al. 2025) 衡量多学科专业视频的专家层面,知识密集型推理. 长 Video-Reason (Chen et al. 2025) 专注于对来自不同现实世界域的长视频的推理. VideoMathQA(Rasheed等人,2025年)评价了时间延伸的数学推理,将教学视频的视觉,文字,音频信息融合在一起.

blocks.en: We conduct all reproduced evaluations within the LMMs-Eval framework ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) and report accuracy following the standard protocol of each benchmark; Video-MMMU further reports Perception, Comprehension, and Adaptation. Evaluation is zero-shot and allows at most 16,384 newly generated tokens. Unless otherwise stated, all reproduced results are averaged over three complete evaluations. The overall average is the unweighted mean of Video-MMMU Avg, TempCompass, MMVU, LongVideo-Reason, and VideoMathQA.
blocks.zh: 我们在LMMs-Eval框架内(Zhang等人,2025年)进行所有重复评价,并按照每个基准的标准协议报告准确性; Video-MMMU进一步报告观念、理解和适应。 评价为零镜头,最多允许16,384个新生成的代币. 除非另有说明,所有转载的结果均在三项完整的评价中进行。 总体平均值为Video-MMMU Avg、TempCompass、MMVU、LongVideo-Reason和VideoMathQA的未加权平均值。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , VideoLVR-8B achieves an average score of 63.95, outperforming Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 2.64 points. It improves over the backbone on every benchmark, indicating that the overall gain is not driven by a single task. As a more direct latent reasoning baseline, LVR-8B applies the MSE feature regression objective of LVR to Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and is trained on our 8.8K synthesized trajectories. VideoLVR-8B surpasses this reproduction by 1.24 points on average and outperforms the reproduced OneThinker-8B on all five benchmarks, demonstrating consistent advantages across different video reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,VideoLVR-8B的平均得分为63.95,比Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct还差2.64分. 它改进了每个基准的支柱,表明总体收益不是由单一任务驱动的。 作为更直接的潜伏推理基线,LVR-8B将LVR的MSE特征回归目标应用到Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct上,并接受关于我们8.8K合成轨迹的培训. VideoLVR-8B平均比这种复制高出1.24分,并且在所有五个基准上都超过了所复制的OneThinker-8B,显示出不同视频推理任务的一贯优势.

blocks.en: The most pronounced gains are on TempCompass and Video-MMMU, with improvements of 3.50 and 3.11 points, respectively. On Video-MMMU, the largest improvement comes from Comprehension, where VideoLVR gains 6.67 points. This pattern aligns with the design of VideoLVR: during training, spatio-temporal annotations ground latent supervision in video moments and local regions, while continuous latent visual states are trained to represent the visual semantics for intermediate reasoning. VideoLVR improves MMVU, LongVideo-Reason, and VideoMathQA, suggesting that its benefits extend beyond temporal perception to expert video understanding, long-range evidence integration, and video-grounded mathematical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 最显著的成绩是TempCompass和Video-MMU,分别改进了3.50分和3.11分。 在Video-MMU上,最大的改进来自Comconferenceon,VideoLVR获得6.67分. 这种模式与VideoLVR的设计一致:在训练期间,Spatio-textional discription在视频瞬间和局部区域进行地面潜伏监督,同时连续潜伏的视觉状态被训练来代表视觉语义,用于中间推理. VideoLVR改进了MMVU,LongVideo-Reason,和VideoMathQA,建议其好处超越时间感知到专家视频理解,远程证据整合,以及视频基于数学推理.

blocks.en:
On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, VideoLVR-7B raises the average score from 50.37 to 53.68 and achieves the highest average among the reproduced protocol-aligned methods based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. It outperforms Open-o3-Video and LVR by 2.30 and 9.09 points on average, respectively. Compared with LVR-7B, the gains are particularly pronounced on LongVideo-Reason and TempCompass. These results show that the improvements brought by VideoLVR are not limited to a particular base model.
After RL, VideoLVR-8B-RL achieves an average of 64.39. Compared with VideoLVR-8B, its average improves by 0.44 points.
blocks.zh:
在Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct上,VideoLVR-7B将平均得分从50.37提高到53.68,并在基于Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的复制协议配对方法中实现了最高的平均值. 其表现分别比Open-o3-Video和LVR平均高出2.30和9.09分. 与LVR-7B相比,LongVideo-Reason和TempCompass的收益尤其明显。 这些结果显示,VideoLVR带来的改进并不限于特定的基础模型.
在RL之后,VideoLVR-8B-RL平均实现64.39. 与VideoLVR-8B相比,其平均改善0.44分.

blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the two latent supervision objectives under the same backbone, training data, and evaluation protocol. Replacing MSE feature regression with visual token prediction improves the average across the five benchmarks from 62.71 to 63.95, yielding a gain of 1.24 points. The improvements are largest on MMVU, VideoMathQA, and LongVideo-Reason, with gains of 2.20, 1.43, and 1.40 points, respectively. This advantage is particularly relevant under temporal redundancy because MSE aligns each latent prediction with its target independently, whereas VTP requires it to distinguish the grounded target from other visually similar tokens in the same video. The overall gain suggests that visual token prediction is more effective than MSE feature regression in improving video understanding performance.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了同一主干、培训数据和评价协议下的两个潜在监督目标。 以视觉信号预测取代MSE的特征回归,使五个基准的平均数从62.71提高到63.95,收益为1.24分。 MMVU,VideoMathQA和LongVideo-Reason的改进最大,分别收获2.20,1.43和1.40分. 这种优势在时间冗余下特别相关,因为MSE将每个潜在预测与目标独立地协调,而VTP则要求它区分被基于目标与同一视频中其他视觉相似的符号. 总体收益表明,在提高视频理解性能方面,视觉符号预测比MSE特征回归更有效.

blocks.en: We apply standard rejection sampling to the training samples and train Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the resulting reasoning trajectories. Unlike our evidence-grounded training data, these trajectories do not contain localized spatio-temporal evidence. As shown in Table 3 , training on evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories improves the average from 62.53 to 63.95. The largest gains appear on VideoMathQA, Video-MMMU, and TempCompass, where the scores increase by 3.57, 2.55, and 2.24 points, respectively. The improvement on LongVideo-Reason is smaller, while MMVU decreases by 1.90 points, showing that the benefit is not uniform across tasks. Overall, the results suggest that associating intermediate reasoning with localized spatio-temporal evidence generally improves video understanding over training on reasoning trajectories obtained through standard rejection sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们在训练样品中应用标准拒绝取样,并训练Qune3-VL-8B-指导由此产生的推理轨迹。 与我们基于证据的训练数据不同的是,这些轨迹并不包含局部的时空证据. 如表3所示,基于证据的推理轨迹培训的平均水平从62.53提高到63.95。 最大的收益出现在VideoMathQA、Video-MMMU和TempCompass上,其得分分别增加了3.57分、2.55分和2.24分。 对LongVideo-Reason的改进较小,而MMVU则减少了1.90分,表明不同任务之间的效益并不一致. 总体而言,结果表明,将中间推理与局部的时空证据联系起来,一般会提高视频对通过标准拒绝抽样获得的推理轨迹培训的了解。

blocks.en: We compare three ways of organizing the localized regions associated with each evidence group. First-Region retains only the first annotated region in each group. Per-Region preserves all regions but assigns each region to a separate latent block. Grouped combines all regions into a single temporally ordered latent block, which is the strategy adopted in VideoLVR. As shown in Table 4 , Grouped achieves the highest average score of 63.95, exceeding First-Region and Per-Region by 0.80 and 0.84 points, respectively. These results suggest that retaining only one region may discard complementary temporal evidence, whereas assigning related regions to separate latent blocks can fragment evidence that jointly supports the same reasoning step. Grouping temporally distributed regions within one latent block better preserves their shared reasoning role. This result further validates the effectiveness of our synthesized training data grounded in localized spatio-temporal evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三种与每个证据小组有关的局部区域组织方式。 第一区只保留每个组的第一个注解区域。 泛区域保留了所有区域,但将每个区域划入一个单独的潜在区块。 分组将所有区域合并为一个按时间顺序排列的潜在块,这是VideoLVR采取的战略。 如表4所示,分组取得最高平均分63.95分,分别超过第一区和佩尔区0.80分和0.84分. 这些结果表明,只保留一个区域可能会丢弃补充时间证据,而将相关区域分配给单独的潜在区块则可能使共同支持同一推理步骤的证据碎裂。 在一个潜在区块内按时间分布的区域分组,能够更好地保持它们共同的推理作用。 这一结果进一步验证了我们基于局部时空证据的综合培训数据的有效性。

Disabling latent visual state generation ( K = 0 K=0 ) yields an average of 62.12, 1.83 points below the 63.95 achieved by K = 8 K=8 , with lower performance on all five benchmarks. Allocating four latent steps recovers part of this gap, raising the average to 62.82, while eight steps provide the strongest overall result. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce VideoLVR, a framework that grounds video reasoning with latent visual evidence constructed from temporally distributed local regions. VideoLVR groups regions according to the reasoning step they support and trains the model to generate the corresponding latent visual states through visual token prediction, thereby interleaving textual reasoning with latent visual evidence in a shared autoregressive process. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning through TVPO, jointly optimizing text and visual token actions with GRPO. Across five video reasoning benchmarks and two backbone models, VideoLVR consistently improves over its base models. Controlled analyses support the benefits of evidence-grounded training data, grouped evidence organization, and visual token prediction, while latent-state interventions further show that the model benefits from the information carried by the generated latent states. Together, these results indicate that localized video evidence can be represented and used during reasoning without inserting additional visual observations into the multimodal context. A remaining limitation is our reliance on synthesized spatio-temporal grounding annotations. Future work could broaden the representational scope of latent visual states beyond localized evidence, enabling them to encode higher-level semantic information.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了VideoLVR,这个框架用从时间分布的局部地区构建的潜在视觉证据来证明视频推理的基础. VideoLVR根据它们支持的推理步骤将区域分组,并训练模型通过视觉符号预测生成相应的潜在视觉状态,从而将文字推理与潜在视觉证据在共享的自回归过程中相互连接. 我们进一步扩展VideoLVR,通过TVPO加强学习,与GRPO共同优化文本和视觉符号行动. 在整个五个视频推理基准和两个主干模型中,VideoLVR在基础模型上不断改进. 受控制的分析支持循证培训数据、分类证据组织和视觉信号预测的好处,而潜在状态干预进一步表明,模型受益于生成的潜在状态所携带的信息。 这些结果表明,局部视频证据可以在推理过程中得到体现和使用,而无需在多式联运上下文中添加额外的视觉观察。 剩下的一个限制因素是,我们依赖综合的时空定位说明。 今后的工作可以将潜在视觉状态的表达范围扩大到局部证据之外,使其能够编码更高层次的语义信息。

This trajectory contains two evidence groups. The first uses regions at 2.3
and 6.4 seconds to ground the visual pattern of food bubbling in hot oil. The
second group uses regions at 20.7 and 22.7 seconds to ground the
subsequent removal and draining of the fried food. During training, the two
regions within each group are ordered by timestamp and concatenated into one
grouped latent target. Each evidence group is then replaced by its corresponding
latent block. Concretely, we use <bot> and <eot> as the
start and end markers, respectively, and <latent> for each latent
position between them. A training block of length L k L_{k} therefore has the form <bot><latent>...<latent><eot> . The hidden state immediately preceding
each <latent> position is supervised to predict the corresponding
visual token in the grouped target. During decoding, generating <bot> initiates latent-state feedback; after K K latent inputs, the controller
inserts <eot> and resumes text generation. The supervised checkpoint
uses projected hidden states as feedback, whereas the reinforcement-learned
model samples visual token indices from the
visual token distribution and uses the corresponding embeddings as
feedback. These sampled indices are discrete visual actions
during RL rollout, and their likelihoods enter the TVPO
objective in Section 3.4 . This yields a
reasoning trajectory interleaved with two latent blocks while omitting textual
evidence annotations, including timestamps and bounding-box coordinates, from
the generation target.
